$comment: DRAFT for developer review. Name: VeloPair (gate #1 closed 2026-08-17); attorney trademark clearance still pending.
title: Ride Profile
description: A rider's riding style, preferably derived from recorded rides rather than a questionnaire. The derivation block tells consumers how trustworthy the numbers are. All values are metric; units are part of the field name.

spec_version.description: Version of this specification the document conforms to.

profile_id.description: Opaque stable identifier chosen by the producing application (a UUID is recommended).

rider_ref.description: profile_id of the Rider this profile describes, when known.

method.description: 'measured' means computed from recorded rides; 'declared' means the rider answered questions; 'mixed' combines both.

ride_count.description: Number of recorded rides the profile was derived from.

window_days.description: Length of the observation window ending at generated_at.

typical_ride_distance_km.description: Median distance of a single ride.

longest_ride_distance_km.description: Longest single ride in the observation window.

weekly_distance_km.description: Mean distance per week over the observation window.

rides_per_week.description: Mean ride count per week over the observation window.

avg_speed_kmh.description: Distance-weighted average moving speed across rides.

elevation_gain_m_per_km.description: Mean climbing per kilometre across rides: the rider's elevation appetite. Flat commuting sits near 2, rolling terrain near 8, mountain riding above 15.

surface_mix.description: Share of distance per surface class. Values should sum to approximately 100.

extensions.description: Producer-specific data under reverse-domain keys. Consumers must ignore unknown extensions.
